Indicator species analysis

Source: R/mp_stats.R
mp_indicator.Rd

Identifies taxa significantly associated with groups (or group combinations) via indicspecies::multipatt() (IndVal.g), and plots the strongest indicators coloured by their associated group.

Usage

mp_indicator(
  object,
  group.by = NULL,
  tax.level = NULL,
  top.n = 20,
  p.threshold = 0.05,
  permutations = 999,
  palette = NULL,
  theme = NULL,
  ...,
  plot.title = NULL,
  plot.subtitle = NULL,
  plot.caption = NULL,
  font.size = getOption("micropubr.font.size", 11),
  interactive = FALSE,
  return.data = FALSE,
  verbose = getOption("micropubr.verbose", FALSE)
)

Arguments

object

A phyloseq::phyloseq object.

group.by

Sample-metadata column defining the groups.

tax.level

Optional rank to agglomerate to first.

top.n

Maximum number of indicator taxa to display.

p.threshold

Significance cut-off on the permutation p-value.

permutations

Number of permutations.

palette, theme, plot.title, plot.subtitle, plot.caption, font.size

See mp_alpha().

...

Passed to the primary geom.

interactive

If TRUE, return an interactive plotly widget instead of a static ggplot (requires plotly). See mp_alpha().

return.data

If TRUE, return the indicator-statistics table.

verbose

Print the methods used.

Value

A ggplot object, a plotly widget when interactive = TRUE, or a data frame when return.data = TRUE.
